# CloudIcon Studio — Free App Icon Generator

> CloudIcon Studio is a free online app icon generator and editor. Upload once and instantly generate production-ready launcher icons, favicons, mipmaps, adaptive icons, and complete export packs for Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop. 100% client-side — no uploads, no servers, no accounts.

## Key pages

- Home: https://cloudicon.vercel.app — Free app icon maker and editor
- Editor: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/editor — Online app icon editor with real-time preview
- How It Works: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/how-it-works — Step-by-step guide to generating app icons
- Documentation: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/docs — Complete documentation for the icon generator
- FAQ: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/faq — Frequently asked questions about app icon generation
- Blog: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/blog — Articles and updates about app icon design
- About: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/about — About CloudIcon Studio
- Contact: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/contact — Support and contact information
- Changelog: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/changelog — Release notes and version history
- Status: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/status — Service uptime and status
- Privacy Policy: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/cookies
- GDPR Compliance: https://cloudicon.vercel.app/gdpr

## Structured data

The site uses JSON-LD schema.org markup including: Organization, WebSite, WebApplication, SoftwareApplication, HowTo, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage.

## Features

- Multi-platform icon export: Android, iOS, Web/PWA, Windows, macOS, and Linux
- 95 assets in the Full Pack, organized into platform-ready folders
- Local U2Net AI background removal via ONNX Runtime Web and WebAssembly
- Chroma-key background removal with corner sampling and tolerance control
- Shared Canvas 2D renderer for the editor, previews, and exports
- Crop, rotate, pan, zoom, padding, fit modes, five shape masks, solid/gradient/transparent backgrounds, adjustments, shadows, borders, and flips
- Undo/redo with an 80-step history and keyboard shortcuts
- Reload-safe editor sessions stored in IndexedDB
- Real-time Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop device mockups
- Android adaptive icons, monochrome and notification icons, plus Play Store artwork
- iOS AppIcon sets with Contents.json
- Web favicons, PWA manifest icons, ICO, and browserconfig
- Desktop export with Windows ICO, macOS ICNS, and Linux PNGs
- ZIP export with per-platform folder hierarchy and an optional README
- 100% client-side — your images never leave your device
- Installable PWA with no automatic install prompt; static assets and the AI model are cached after first use
- No accounts, analytics, or tracking cookies

## Technologies

Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Fabric.js, Zustand + zundo, Framer Motion, onnxruntime-web, JSZip, and custom ICO/ICNS encoders. Deployed on Vercel.

## Storage

- Editor session: IndexedDB (`cloudicon-db` / `state` / `cloudicon-editor-state-v2`)
- Export history: localStorage (last 50 exports)
- Theme and cookie-consent preferences: localStorage

No artwork is uploaded to a server.
